title: No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 02, upline security), APPR
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours because of delay code 02 (late positioning due to upline security, uncontrollable). The customer chooses not to travel and stays at the origin. Checks that No Travel Origin plus an uncontrollable security delay code returns Not Eligible under APPR, with a full ticket refund entitlement.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC042: one adult passenger, one AC domestic leg YUL?YYZ, AC 460, May 28, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:20 (260 min late). Actual arrival 16:25 (265 min late). No cancellation code. First arrival delay code 02 (US). First departure delay code 02 (US). Passenger not boarded and coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted.
